title: Output Schema for PGP Verify Operation
description: Output schema for the cryptography pgpVerify operation.

payload.description: The recovered payload from the signed message: text (outputType=TEXT) or base64 of the bytes (outputType=BASE64). Present in the response variable when overwriteBody is false; when overwriteBody is true it is written to the message body instead.

signatureValid.description: Whether the signature verified successfully against the supplied public key(s).

fileName.description: The original file name embedded in the message, when present (absent for the default _CONSOLE sentinel).

modificationTime.description: The modification time embedded in the message as an ISO-8601 instant, when present.

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
